note: Declarative map 'bank event type -> observation source -> observable fields'. The SOLE carrier of correspondences: run_live_bank.py reads this file and hard-codes no pair. An entry is either {status: mappable} with a machine rule the normalizer implements, or {status: unmappable} with a named reason. 'Unmappable' is a MEASUREMENT RESULT, never an invitation to invent a source (D83, P3.9 Code Guidance).

sources.stream-json: (a) the `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` event stream: `system.init`, `assistant` blocks carrying `tool_use`, `user` blocks carrying `tool_result`, and the terminal `result` object (findings/15-cli-observability-probe.md)
sources.git-state: (b) git state of the dispatch worktree: `git diff --name-only <base>` plus `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`
sources.journal-delta: (c) lines appended to `plans/<ID>/journal.jsonl` during the dispatch window
sources.trace-record: (d) `analyst.trace.build_trace_record` records actually produced during the dispatch
sources.reason-code: (e) literal reason codes of `task.task_contract` / `task.review_policy` extracted from (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) — the closed literal channel below

forbidden_sources: grep over the model's final text or any prose it emitted — a prosaic 'I compiled the contract' is exactly the claim-stronger-than-fact this plan exists to cure (D83)
the dispatched session's own self-report of what it did

reason codes of modules OUTSIDE `task.task_contract`/`task.review_policy` (e.g. `task.command_render`'s `CMD_*`, `task.route_evidence`'s `ROUTE_ACTUAL_*`) — the D83 list is closed, and widening it is a D#, not a local decision here

reason_code_channel.declared_codes_provenance: every literal in `packages/task/lib/task/task_contract.py` (18) and `packages/task/lib/task/review_policy.py` (3) that the module RETURNS or RAISES as a typed reason code; extracted by `grep -o '"[A-Z][A-Z_]\{5,\}"'` and filtered against the two modules' declared code surfaces on the item's tree
reason_code_channel.known_limitation: the channel matches LITERAL tokens in a `tool_result`. A dispatch that merely PRINTS a code (grep over source, `--help`) yields a false-positive `block`. The direction is fail-safe: a spurious `block` makes a control case FAIL and an `event_absent block` assertion RED — it never turns red into green. Named here rather than papered over; a stricter channel (structured compiler output artifact) is a candidate for a future item, not a silent widening here.

sanitizer.note: Privacy/minimization stage that runs BEFORE normalization and is recorded as the fixture's raw (`stage: sanitized-raw`). Not part of the map's semantics — declared here so a reader knows exactly what the recorded raw does and does not contain.
rules: the dispatch worktree's absolute path is rewritten to the literal `<WT>`; any residual `/home/` in the recorded bytes is a hard failure (lesson F8: no host-bound absolute path in a committed artifact)
assistant `text` and `thinking` blocks are DROPPED ENTIRELY — the recorded raw carries no model prose, which makes `forbidden_sources[0]` structurally impossible rather than merely forbidden
`tool_use` inputs keep only path-shaped values (`file_path`, `path`, `notebook_path`, `pattern`) plus the KEY NAMES of everything else; a `Bash` `command` string is dropped (it can carry secrets)
`tool_result` text is reduced to the matched `declared_codes` and `predicate_verdicts` — nothing else survives
the terminal `result` object keeps status/usage/cost/session fields; its `result` prose field is dropped
sanitizer.consequence_recorded_as_measurement: because absolute paths outside the worktree cannot be rewritten worktree-relative, they are ERASED, not preserved. An assertion naming a host-bound absolute literal therefore has no source — see `outcome_fields[execution_inputs].unmappable_value_domain`.

normalization.seq: assigned 1..N after ordering; `event_order` assertions read it
normalization.determinism: the normalized transcript/outcome is a pure function of the recorded raw plus this map — no clock, no randomness, no host paths

events.note: git state is the SINGLE mutation source: `tool_use` Write/Edit are deliberately NOT a second source (a Write that the tree does not show never happened, and counting both would double-count).
presence is observable (the file changed); `carrier_matches_next` is NOT — nothing computes whether the written carrier equals the plan's actual Next (`grep carrier_matches_next packages/` is empty).
a `where.reason_code` naming a code OUTSIDE `declared_codes` has no source: the code does not exist in any module, so no artifact can ever carry it.

presence is observable via the compiler's own literal verdict channel. NONE of the three asserted `where` keys is: `requirements_complete`, `cold_start_complete` and `authority_class` are absent from the verdict channel (`authority.class` lives inside the compiled contract dict, which the sanitizer does not record).
not asserted by any bank case; mapped because the channel exists and the normalizer emits it.

the pre-mutation predicate CONTAINS the portability classification (`task_contract.pre_mutation` ranks 5-6 -> `portability_lint`), so its verdict is evidence the check ran. `privacy_checked` is not observable: `bundle_lint` is a separate entry point with no verdict in this channel.

derived_fields.undershoot: a ROUTE_UNDERSHOOT reason code was observed in this dispatch

events.note: a journal line's `actor` IS the declared route. `printed_in_report` and `claimed` are not observable: neither is a field of any artifact — the first is a property of the human-facing report, the second of the report's wording.

events.reason: a headless `claude -p` dispatch has no owner channel at all: asking manifests only as prose in the final text, and prose is a forbidden source. `permission_denials` in the `result` object is a DIFFERENT event (a tool permission refusal), not a question to the owner, and equating them would be inventing a source.
requires 'work remaining and no typed reason'. 'Work remaining' is not a machine state in any of the five sources: nothing compares the dispatch's stopping point to the plan's outstanding items.

same channel as `owner_question` (an approval request is a question) plus a second missing half — 'already granted in scope' would need the standing-delegation state, which no artifact carries per dispatch.

no runtime emitter. `task_contract._count_audit_rounds` counts `## Audit Pn` blocks in the PLAN file — a property of the plan document, not of the dispatch being measured; using it would grade the wrong subject.

`review_policy.evaluate_finding` computes `finding_id` as library code and has no session-boundary caller (the same absence `cases.json::audit-reopens-bookkeeping-as-product` probes: `absent_pattern finding_id|reopen_of|finding_class` over `packages/*/lib/**/*.py` still holds for CALLERS). No dispatch artifact carries a typed finding, so `class`/`finding_id`/`reopened_green`/`authored_next`/`recorded` have no source either.

'a public/consumer-facing path was exercised' is not a machine-distinguishable class of tool call: nothing in the stream, the tree or the journal marks a command as consumer-facing. Declaring some tool subset 'consumer' here would be exactly the invented source D83 forbids.

the probes that exist (`skiller.quality.eval.provider_capability_matrix`, `task.command_render.CMD_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`) live OUTSIDE the closed reason-code source list, and neither has a session-boundary caller that would leave an artifact. Note the asymmetry recorded honestly: the `block` code `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED` IS declared (it is `task_contract`'s), but the probe EVENT is not.
skiller resolves identities at connect/registry time, not per dispatch; no artifact of a dispatch records which carrier served an identity, so `carriers`/`ambiguous`/`scope` have no source.

hook execution is not represented in `--output-format stream-json` (findings/15 enumerates the stream's object types) and no hook writes an invocation record. Not asserted by any bank case either, but mapped explicitly so the map covers the full 17+1-type vocabulary rather than only the asserted subset.

a generated projection landing in the tree is visible as `mutation`, but the asserted fields `version_bumped` and `provenance_hash` are not emitted by any publication path — no artifact states that a version was bumped or that a provenance hash was written.

rule.derivation: `failed` if result.is_error; else `blocked` if any `block` event was emitted; else `success`
sorted unique `target`s of the `read` events, worktree-relative

outcome_fields.unmappable_value_domain: an absolute path (a host-bound input) — the F8 sanitizer erases it before recording, so an assertion naming such a literal can never be observed and is counted `unmappable`. This is a real limitation of the privacy rule, recorded as a measurement rather than worked around.

outcome_fields.reason: no artifact declares the acceptance scope of a dispatch; `public_acceptance` lives in the compiled contract, which the sanitizer does not record.
nothing computes it — `grep cold_start_complete|carrier_matches_next packages/` is empty (the same absence the bank's own probe asserts).
the effective hook set spanning global+project sources is a harness inventory property, not a dispatch artifact.
measured by P1.4 over a declared unit fixture, not by any dispatch.
`bundle_lint`'s class vocabulary is not emitted per dispatch; only its reason codes would be, and they are not this field.
harness ownership state, not a dispatch artifact.
`command_render` resolution lives outside the closed reason-code list and has no session-boundary caller.
no artifact declares an evidence bundle minimized.
`grep next_declared packages/` is empty — the field exists only in the bank's own declared baseline outcome.
would require checking the committed handoff against the plan's actual Next; nothing does.
present inside the compiled contract (`portability.provider_renderers`), which the sanitizer does not record; the verdict channel carries codes, not contract fields.
same as `acceptance_scopes`: a compiled-contract field, outside the recorded channel.
no artifact enumerates satisfied requirements per dispatch.
'approved-goal vs diagnostic-drift' is a judgement about the dispatch's subject matter, with no machine carrier.
`grep route_attribution|self_attributed packages/` is empty — the attribution class is not fixed machine-side anywhere (this is exactly the honesty boundary `plan-run.md` names).
a compiled-contract field (`portability.semantic_carrier`), outside the recorded channel.
no artifact declares the audit's terminal state.

`task_contract.classify_tier`'s output lives inside the compiled contract, outside the verdict channel; only a `PORTABILITY_TIER_MISCLASSIFIED` code would be observable, and that is a different proposition than the tier's value.
harness hook-resolution state, not a dispatch artifact.
no publication path emits it.
